messages:
alex: Hey team — PR ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8934. It updates the SDK REST client (tool-calling headers) and adds a streaming cancel token. Need 1 approval before EOD to cut a patch release. CI showing a flaky test on macos-builder. Can someone take a look? cc @sara @jonah
sara: On it, will run locally in ~30m.
jonah: Quick skim looks small. One concern: header rename from `X-Redwood-Tools` -> `X-Redwood-Tool` could break self-hosted clients. Did you add a migration note?
alex: Good catch — just added a migration blurb to CHANGELOG and included a tiny compatibility shim so the SDK accepts both headers (commit 7f3b2c). Also pushed a fix for the streaming stub that was causing the test to fail.
sara: Running the full test matrix now. FYI the failing stack was in `streaming_test` — assertion in cancel handling: ```AssertionError: expected 0, got 1
    at streaming_client.test.ts:42:15```
ci-bot: macos-builder failed on run #512 (timeout). Re-running job...
ci-bot: macos-builder run #513 — ✅ passed
jonah: LGTM, modulo adding an integration test for header compatibility. Can you add `integration/clients/headers.test.ts`? If you're swamped I can open a quick follow-up PR.
alex: I'll add the integration test in a follow-up. This PR is a patch (bugfix) and I'd prefer to merge now if CI stays green — changelog + shim are in.
sara: Approved :thumbsup: I'll merge after the final green and tag the release.
deploy-bot: merged PR #8934 into main and created tag v1.12.5
alex: Thanks all!
